records.coverage: Delhi Jal Board water and sewerage service areas in NCT Delhi; confirm the local operator for the address.
records.description: Delhi Jal Board publishes 1916 for water and sewer complaints. Its official control-room page also lists locality-specific water contacts.
steps: Call the DJB complaint helpline and explain the water or sewer issue and its location.
Keep the complaint reference number and use it when checking status or following up.

contactPhone.purpose: Delhi Jal Board water and sewer complaint helpline

records.offlineOption: DJB also publishes 1800117118 as a toll-free central control-room number.
exceptions: This is a DJB contact and does not cover every water supplier in India. Confirm that the problem belongs to DJB.
The linked page is official contact guidance, not an online complaint form.
conditions: Storm-water drainage and sewerage can have different responsible authorities; ask DJB to confirm responsibility for the reported asset.
records.escalation: Use the saved complaint reference to request status through the DJB helpline.

records.department: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB)
records.coverage: BWSSB-served areas of Bengaluru; confirm the applicable BWSSB service station.
records.description: Use the BWSSB complaint form or its 1916 helpline for water-supply and sewerage issues within the board service area.
steps: Open the official complaint form and provide the required contact, address and complaint details.
Choose the applicable category and provide the RR number if available.
Submit after review and retain the complaint reference; use View Complaint or call 1916 for follow-up.

contactPhone.purpose: BWSSB water and sewer service helpline

exceptions: BWSSB is not the water operator for all Karnataka locations. Use this contact only for the board service area.
conditions: The complaint form accepts an RR number but does not mark it mandatory; provide it if available.
Confirm whether a drainage issue concerns a BWSSB sewer or an asset maintained by another authority.
records.escalation: Track the complaint using the official complaint system or ask the helpline for the responsible service station.

records.department: Chennai Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (CMWSSB)
records.coverage: CMWSSB operational area in Chennai; confirm the responsible area or depot office for the address.
records.description: Chennai Metrowater operates a water and sewer complaint cell on 044-45674567. The official guidance explains telephone, area-office and online complaint routes.
steps: Call the complaint cell and describe the water or sewer problem and its exact location.
Retain the complaint registration number or SMS for follow-up with the relevant area or depot office.
Check the official complaint guidance for current online availability and further redressal options.

contactPhone.purpose: Chennai Metrowater 24-hour water and sewer complaint cell

records.offlineOption: CMWSSB also publishes 1916 for water/sewer complaints and accepts complaints through its area or depot offices.
exceptions: This contact is for CMWSSB operations, not every water service in Tamil Nadu.
The linked CMWSSB online complaint system displayed a maintenance page when checked on 19 September 2026; use the published phone route if online filing remains unavailable.
conditions: The action link opens official complaint guidance. It is not itself a submission form.
CMWSSB sewerage and municipal storm-water drains can have different responsibilities; confirm the relevant asset and office.
records.escalation: Use the complaint reference when following up with the area/depot office or Grievance Cell described in the official guidance.

records.department: Tamil Nadu Power Distribution Corporation (TNPDCL) - Minnagam / CCMS
records.coverage: TNPDCL electricity consumers and distribution assets in Tamil Nadu; confirm the supplier shown on the electricity bill.
records.description: Report a power failure or other TNPDCL supply complaint through the Consumer Complaint Management System or the Minnagam call centre on 9498794987.
requiredDetails: Valid mobile number for portal registration and OTP
steps: Call Minnagam or open CCMS and register using a valid mobile number and OTP.
Choose the applicable service-related or general complaint and describe the supply fault and location.
Keep the complaint reference and use CCMS to track the complaint.

contactPhone.purpose: TNPDCL Minnagam 24-hour consumer complaint and power-support line

records.offlineOption: Call Minnagam on 9498794987 for TNPDCL complaints.
exceptions: This route is for TNPDCL customers and assets, not every electricity provider in India.
conditions: CCMS is the direct consumer complaint route. The Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum is a separate grievance procedure.
The complaint channel does not establish a universal fault-repair deadline.
records.escalation: Track the complaint in CCMS or follow up with Minnagam using its reference number.

records.coverage: BESCOM consumers in its Karnataka distribution area, including Bengaluru; other Karnataka distribution companies use their own service channels.
records.description: BESCOM publishes 1912 for customer help and provides service-request and complaint functions on its consumer portal. Use this route for a supply problem when BESCOM is the electricity supplier.
steps: Confirm that the electricity bill identifies BESCOM as the supplier.
Call 1912 to report the supply fault, or use the consumer portal complaint/service-request function.
Provide the affected address and available account details, then retain the complaint or request reference for follow-up.

contactPhone.purpose: BESCOM customer help and electricity complaint line

exceptions: BESCOM does not supply all Karnataka locations. This record does not claim nationwide or statewide coverage for 1912.
conditions: Use the supplier shown on the bill to confirm jurisdiction.
Portal functions may require consumer registration or login. No universal restoration time is promised.
records.escalation: Use the portal request tracker or customer care with the existing complaint reference.
records.serviceScope: BESCOM consumers within its distribution area only
